paragraphs.text:
You tell the man that you’re a collector of antiquities, and that 
you heard there’s going to be an estate sale of some items of 
interest here. The ferryman nods slowly. “You heard right, friend. 
Professor Harris’ things are being sold off by his widow, Amelia, 
at an estate sale tonight. Shame about what happened to him, but 
his loss is your gain I suppose.” The ferryman hesitates a moment 
before extending a hand toward you in greeting. “I’m Lance 
Sanford by the way. Pleased to make your acquaintance.”
• To inquire about Prof. Harris, go to 27.
• To ask Lance Sanford about himself, go to 42.
• To ask about the estate sale, go to 66.
• To ask about the widow Amelia, go to 89.
• To pass the time waiting to arrive in Esbury, go to 56.
